# Every released BC minor from 27.0 on, one per line (CONTRIBUTING.md, "Version-gated tests (preprocessor directives)").
# The only list of minors: .github/scripts/ci-legs.py derives the CI legs (the newest minor of each major) and the
# preprocessor symbols of every version from it. The pull request that moves a leg to a new minor adds the minor here.
# "Released": Microsoft publishes it as a sandbox artifact for production use; never a release candidate or insider build.
